name: BookReturnWorkflow
description: Comprehensive workflow managing book returns including transaction closure, overdue fine calculation, inventory update, reservation fulfillment check, and notification to waiting members

data.label: Start Book Return
data.description: Initiate book return process when member returns a book

data.label: Process Return
data.description: Librarian scans book and verifies condition, records return in system

data.label: Validate Transaction
data.description: Verify active transaction exists for this book and member

data.label: Calculate Overdue Fine
data.description: Calculate fine amount based on days overdue and membership type

data.label: Fine Due?
data.description: Check if overdue fine needs to be applied

data.label: Create Fine Record
data.description: Create fine record in database and link to member account

data.label: Close Transaction
data.description: Update transaction status to completed and record return date

data.label: Update Inventory
data.description: Update book status to available and increment available copies count

data.label: Reservation Exists?
data.description: Check if any member has reserved this book

data.label: Fulfill Reservation
data.description: Assign book to next member in reservation queue

data.label: Notify Reserved Member
data.description: Send notification to member that reserved book is now available

data.label: Notify Return Complete
data.description: Send confirmation notification to returning member

data.label: End
data.description: Book return process completed successfully
